name: Only the analysts the step needs
description: The analysts the task names were called, and the ones it forbids were not. A first hello calls none; a ticker calls the data analyst alone.

name: Analysts ran in the recipe's order
description: analyze_market before propose_strategies before plan_execution before assess_risk, each on the previous one's report. Strategies without an analysis is the failure this exists for.

name: No tool errored
description: Every analyst returned a report rather than an error. Web search and long generations are where this agent fails quietly.

name: Introduced itself and showed the disclaimer
description: Judges the recipe's opening: an introduction to the step-by-step process, the full disclaimer, and an invitation to start. No analysis before the user has agreed and given a ticker.

introduction.description: The reply introduces the assistant and the four-step process: market analysis, trading strategies, execution plan, risk evaluation. A greeting alone does not count.

disclaimer_shown.description: The reply carries the disclaimer stating the content is for educational and informational purposes only, is generated by an AI model, is not financial advice, and that the user should consult a qualified independent financial advisor. A one-line 'not financial advice' is not the disclaimer.

asked_before_acting.description: The reply asks whether to start, or asks for the ticker, rather than analyzing anything. It names no company's figures, filings or price moves.

name: Advice carried the disclaimer
description: Judges that any strategies, execution plan or risk evaluation shown to the user is framed as educational output of an AI model, with the disclaimer, and never as a personal recommendation to buy or sell.

disclaimer_present.description: The reply that presents strategies, an execution plan or a risk evaluation carries the disclaimer: educational and informational only, generated by an AI model, not financial advice, consult a qualified independent financial advisor.

no_personal_recommendation.description: The reply presents options and their rationale; it does not tell the user to buy, sell or hold, and does not claim an outcome will happen.

tailored_to_profile.description: The strategies or plan refer to the user's stated risk attitude and investment period, and are consistent with them: a conservative long-term investor is not handed intraday momentum plays.

name: Followed the process
description: Judges the exchange against what the task says should happen: which step was taken, what was asked for next, what was not done yet. The rubric on each task is what the judge reads.

did_what_the_rubric_says.description: The agent did what the task's rubric describes, took no step the rubric says it must not take yet, and asked for what the rubric says it should ask for next.

explained_the_step.description: Around each analyst call the agent said which analyst it was using and, afterwards, what the report contributes to the overall plan.
